title: VerdictInput
description: Input to the verdict-promotion state machine. Drives the go/delay/alternate decision based on prior verdict, prior flag, current flag, and whether the workplace has an alternate task that can be substituted at black.

priorVerdict.description: The verdict returned on the previous run, or null on the first run.

priorFlag.description: The environmental flag observed on the previous run. Should be null when priorVerdict is null (first-run state).

currentFlag.description: The environmental flag observed on this run.

hasAlternateAvailable.description: Whether the workplace has an alternate task (e.g., indoor admin work) that can be substituted when conditions reach black flag.
